prompt: Compose a bebop head in Eb major, 203 BPM allegro, 4/4, about 96 bars and about three and a half minutes, scored for sax, piano, bass and drums in 4 voices. Texture: fast eighth-note lines with chromatic approach over chained ii-V-I. Open with 4 bars of sax alone, then layer the other parts in one at a time. The main section runs on a 4-bar diatonic loop of I–V–vi–IV, unchanged throughout. Thin the middle section to two voices for two descending phrases, then return with everything for the fullest passage. Dynamics start at mp, push to f in the middle and settle back to mp for a sustained tonic close. Aim for the feeling of leaves in an autumn courtyard. Use no ornament symbols; write every note out. This piece opens with an 8-bar solo piano loop of sparkling arpeggios in E major, evoking the early morning light through a window. The chords and rhythm make a clear, driving pattern that flows into layered additions of guitar, bass, strings, and drums, evoking a full J-pop ensemble with a modern, polished sound. The middle section thinns the textures back into just two voices, giving space and clarity to the melody, before building back up to a climactic, full-bodied ending. Dynamics move from **pp** to **mf** in the middle, then back to **pp** for a softened close.

prompt: Compose a classical theme and variations in G major, 91 BPM andante, 4/4, about 88 bars and about three and a half minutes, scored for solo piano in 2 voices. Texture: an eight-bar theme followed by three variations of increasing density. Open with 8 bars establishing the accompaniment before the melody enters on an upbeat. The main section runs on a 8-bar diatonic loop of I–IV–V–I, unchanged throughout. Thin the middle section to two voices for two descending phrases, then return with everything for the fullest passage. Dynamics start at p, push to mf in the middle and settle back to p for a sustained tonic close. Aim for the feeling of a desk lamp late at night. Use no ornament symbols; write every note out. Output the complete piece as ABC notation.
